children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Polycab India

Polycab’s revenue/EBITDA grew ~53%/44% YoY to INR98.9b/INR14.2b (15%/16% beat) in 2QFY27. Cable & wire (C&W) revenue rose ~47% YoY to INR83.8b (~9% beat), and FMEG revenue jumped 2.2x YoY to INR9.9b (42% beat). OPM dipped 90bp YoY to ~14.4% due to a decline of 90bp in C&W margin to 14.2% (+90bp vs. estimate). Adj. PAT increased ~48% YoY to INR9.8b (~22% beat), aided by higher-than-estimated other income. Domestic C&W revenues grew at 50% YoY; while; international business recorded 17% YoY growth. Volume growth was in the mid-to-high single digits with wire growth outpacing cable growth. Management expects healthy C&W demand to remain intact in 2HFY27. FMEG continued to outperform, led by solar inverters, with margins in double digits for the first time.

We increase our EPS estimates by ~9%/4% for FY27/FY28 on strong earnings beat. The stock trades at 34x/31x FY27E/FY28E EPS. We value Polycab at 40x FY28E EPS to arrive at our TP of INR10,600. Reiterate BUY.
